name: Dense graphs on 20 vertices without K3,3
description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..19 in which no three vertices have three common neighbours (no K3,3). Maximize the number of edges. A K3,3-free graph with m edges certifies ex(20;K3,3) >= m; no exact value for n = 20 is documented here.

sources.locator: W. G. Brown, On Graphs that do not Contain a Thomsen Graph (1966). A K3,3-free graph with m edges certifies ex(20;K3,3) >= m; no exact value for n = 20 is documented here.
